_README:
Rungs a RULING added that no scraped source file carries.

The builder reads this on every run, so a regenerate cannot lose them.
They were previously hand-edited into the GENERATED file, which works
exactly once: the next regenerate rewrites from the sources and the
ruling is silently gone.

MERGE RULE: an entry is added only when the product ladder does not
already carry the name. When a source finally publishes the rung, the
SOURCE wins and the overlay entry becomes a no-op -- so this file retires
itself rather than fighting a future scrape.

NOT A SCRAPE. Each entry names its own ruling and source; nothing here is
synthetic (feedback_no_synthetic_parallels_only_actuals) -- these rungs
are checklist-backed in card_catalog, they simply were never scraped into
a CSV.
